summary.zh: 鸡蛋 6 个 · 奶油奶酪 250 g · 玉米淀粉 40 g · 水浴
summary.en: 6 eggs · 250 g cream cheese · 40 g cornstarch · water bath

amount.en: 60 g (appears to be 60 g after correction)

steps.zh: 奶油奶酪与黄油软化；原文随后写牛奶与粉、奶油，具体混合顺序待核。
steps.en: Soften the cream cheese and butter. The original then mentions milk, flour/starch, and cream; the exact mixing order needs confirmation.

steps.zh: 蛋白打至湿性发泡，笔记提醒低速打发、分次加糖、不要打过头；另写「半个柠檬」，用法待核。
steps.en: Beat the egg whites to soft peaks. The note advises beating on low speed, adding the sugar in stages, and not overbeating. It also says “half a lemon”; how to use it needs confirmation.

steps.zh: 采用水浴法。原文写「290 度」约 1 小时，接着「230 度」30 分钟；关火后闷约两小时，再放凉入冰箱。
steps.en: Use a water bath. The original says “290 degrees” for about 1 hour, followed by “230 degrees” for 30 minutes; leave in the switched-off oven for about 2 hours, then cool and refrigerate.

steps.zh: 下次试烤：若使用约 8 寸模、水浴且蛋糕糊高度相近，可先试 300°F（约 150°C）45 分钟，再降至 250°F（约 120°C）15 分钟，关火静置约 30 分钟。总烘烤约 60 分钟；按表面上色和中心凝固情况调整。此为参考配方的试验方案，尚非本配方的实测结果。
steps.en: Next test bake: if using an approximately 8-inch pan, a water bath, and a similar batter depth, first try 300°F (about 150°C) for 45 minutes, then reduce to 250°F (about 120°C) for 15 minutes; leave in the switched-off oven for about 30 minutes. Total baking time is about 60 minutes; adjust based on browning and how set the center is. This is a trial plan based on a reference recipe, not a tested result for this recipe.

notes.zh: 原记「290／230 度」按美式烤箱推测为 °F，但单位尚未确认；第一段旁另有「50」字迹。模具尺寸与实际蛋糕糊高度待补，若用更小、更深的模具，不能直接套用 60 分钟。可参看下厨房八寸轻乳酪蛋糕水浴烤法：https://m.xiachufang.com/recipe/103498478/
notes.en: The original “290/230 degrees” is inferred to mean °F based on an American oven, but the unit is unconfirmed; “50” is also written beside the first stage. Pan size and actual batter depth need to be added. Do not apply the 60-minute time directly to a smaller, deeper pan. Reference: Xiachufang water-bath method for an 8-inch light cheesecake: https://m.xiachufang.com/recipe/103498478/

displayStatus.zh: 手写配方 · 部分待辨
